events.title: Falcon 9 · CRS-35 to the ISS
events.fallbackLabel: Watch the live broadcast on X
events.imageCredit: Photo: NASA/Kim Shiflett (CRS-25 liftoff), public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launches Cargo Dragon C211 on NASA's 35th SpaceX resupply mission from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral, carrying more than 6,300 lb of supplies, science and the final pair of ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays. The booster is on its eighth flight and will land at Landing Zone 40; Dragon docks with the station on Thursday 15 Oct around 11:00 a.m. ET.

events.title: Dragon · CRS-35 docks with the ISS
events.imageCredit: Photo: NASA/Kim Shiflett (CRS-25 liftoff), public domain
events.description: Cargo Dragon C211 on CRS-35 docks autonomously with the ISS around 11:00 a.m. ET (NASA coverage from about 9:15 a.m. ET). SpaceX confirmed the docking time after CRS-35 liftoff. No site-embeddable stream id verified yet — watch on NASA Live.

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-481
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: A Falcon 9 national security launch for the U.S. Space Force from SLC-4E at Vandenberg, California, with a four-hour window opening at 4:44 p.m. PT (7:44 p.m. ET). The payload is classified; the first stage lands on a droneship, and a backup opportunity is on Friday 16 Oct at 4:35 p.m. PT.

events.title: Tesla Roadster reveal
events.imageCredit: 2020 Roadster prototype · Photo: Smnt, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: Tesla's next-generation Roadster, first shown in 2017, gets its live demo near Waco, Texas. Tesla moved it from 1 October because the event can only be held outdoors and severe weather was forecast. Tesla on X (14 Oct): streaming live Thursday 15 Oct at 7:55pm CST (Central / CDT local). This switches to LIVE as soon as the official stream is up.

events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call
events.imageCredit: Photo: Steve Jurvetson, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
events.description: Tesla posts its Q3 2026 results after the US market close, then management holds a live Q&A webcast at 4:30pm Central Time. The webcast and replay are on ir.tesla.com, which can't be embedded here.

events.title: Starship Flight 15
events.imageCredit: Photo: Shujianyang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: Starship's fifteenth flight test from Starbase, Texas, targeted no earlier than 8 November. It's expected to be the first serious attempt to catch a Ship back at the tower.
